_comment: Three generated act-2 runs on the same checkpoint, compared at the boss node.
All three share current_node_type and encounter_id, and all three drive the boss to dead,
yet the engine completes two and returns the third to Map where the action mask empties.
This artifact is what decides the claim that has flip-flopped twice in this report.
enemy_sum_min_in_first_12_rows is the minimum surviving enemy-HP total over the first 12 recorded boss decisions -- not a final value; the boss being dead is carried separately by boss_emptied.
